definitions.explanation: A particular sector of business or trade, or the people and companies involved in it. Often used to refer to the collective community of professionals in a given field.

examples.japanese: IT{業界|ぎょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work in the IT industry.

examples.japanese: {業界|ぎょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦チェックしている→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧。
examples.english: I always keep an eye on industry trends.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{業界|ぎょうかい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦アイデア→アイデア：10161_aidea⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: In this industry, new ideas are valued more than experience.

notes:
USAGE:
Used to refer to a specific sector of business or trade. Often preceded by the field name: IT{業界|ぎょうかい}, {出版|しゅっぱん}{業界|ぎょうかい} (publishing industry), {飲食|いんしょく}{業界|ぎょうかい} (food and drink industry). {業界|ぎょうかい}{人|じん} refers to an industry insider.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {業界|ぎょうかい}{最大手|さいおおて}: the biggest in the industry
- {業界|ぎょうかい}⟦{団体|だんたい}→団体：03426_dantai⟧: industry association
- {業界|ぎょうかい}⟦{動向|どうこう}→動向：05580_doukou⟧: industry trends
- {業界|ぎょうかい}⟦{用語|ようご}→用語：04086_yougo⟧: industry jargon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{業種|ぎょうしゅ}→業種：13149_gyoushu⟧: type of industry (focuses on the category, not the community)
- ⟦{分野|ぶんや}→分野：03612_bunya⟧: field, area (broader, not limited to business)
